description: Deterministic entry, one private structured review20 model step, pure reconcile30/validate40, directed correction45 and byte-preserving finalize50. Drafts and validation context stay private; finalize50 confirms an authoritative permit and conditionally publishes the exact in-memory snapshot.

invocation.ui: The same structured object, with expectedRevisionId supplied by the UI.
invocation.project: Required from the selected host project (mls.actualProject), never inferred from stored modules.
invocation.invalidInput: A status-only task with root LLM skipped; no source or candidate write.

writes: private task long memory only: frozen validation context, its hash and correctionAttemptsUsed
executableSteps.goal: Freeze the explicit project, module, base, change, revision and request after validating both folder references and all source hashes.

writes: private task result only (maximum 280000 serialized characters, including the sealed base and snapshot hashes required by reconcile30)
executableSteps.goal: Produce and deterministically validate either policy-qualified scalar replacements or a clarification without writing L4 storage.

reads: validated review20 private result containing sealed base, proposal, snapshot hashes, validation context hash and correction state
writes: private task result only (maximum 400000 serialized characters)
executableSteps.goal: Run only mechanically demonstrable dependency gates, preserve the proposal byte-for-byte and return ready, clarification or unsupported without any transformation.

reads: verified private correction chain and its correctionAttemptsUsed
writes: private validation result only (maximum 550000 serialized characters)
correction45 step only for a correctable invalid draft below the limit
finalize50 step only when every affected gate is checked
executableSteps.goal: Validate the current private draft with the real context frozen at entry, preserve the draft and counter, and classify ready, clarification, unsupported or invalid without consuming a correction attempt.

writes: private corrected draft and exact mutations only when a real safe correction occurs
executableSteps.goal: Restore only exact invalid scalar targets to their frozen-base values, increment the request counter only after a real mutation, stop at three, and fail closed without changing the draft or counter when no safe target exists.

reads: complete verified correction chain and its authoritative counter
fresh authoritative candidate pointer/snapshot when replay misses
executableSteps.goal: Reconstruct and verify every correction and validation through the final counter, rerun deterministic validation, rehash frozen bytes, rebuild the exact snapshot, then replay a durable submitted attempt or mark and conditionally publish it.

reservedNotScheduled.reason: Publication is complete, but no button, shared CLI or implementation run is connected by this private agent.

safety: entry10 and reconcile30 make no LLM call; review20 makes exactly one structured call and has no automatic retry.
Before finalize50, drafts remain only in bounded private task step state; finalize50 may write only the permit-gated candidate revision, never the original L4, materializers or planner dispatch.
reconcile30 recomputes review diffs, accepts no mutation and turns clarification/unsupported into private terminal state rather than inventing dependencies.
validate40 rechecks identity, revision, hashes, context hash, affected areas and the complete correction chain; it neither rereads stor/tobe nor consumes a correction attempt.

correction45 is deterministic and may only restore an exact invalid scalar to the corresponding frozen-base scalar; no safe mutation means no attempt is consumed, and a resumed request keeps its persisted count up to the hard limit of three.

finalize50 reconstructs the complete correction chain to the authoritative final counter, reruns deterministic validation, reads the immutable revision namespace rather than tobe/plan, refuses any altered draft/areas/validation or byte drift, and never serializes CandidateSnapshot bytes into task results.
A missing or stale active revision is a refusal, not an implicit snapshot rewrite.
This flow does not report an accepted review or completed release.
